tests.name: draft, full source audio, bounded layout and distinct prediction layers
direct move commits only on release, preserves fractional pitch and correct note identity
resize clamps neighbours and source bounds, with undo/redo
split, compatible merge, delete, drawing and undo/redo use the same edit history
multi-selection moves two notes and region uncertainty has undo/redo
pitch keyboard stays aligned after time/pitch zoom and middle pan
saved reference edits survive refresh; revision restore appends an unreviewed revision
working corrections and reference histories stay independent
review queue uses measurable disagreement, never verifies references automatically
piano keys generate measured A4 and A sharp frequencies without starting vocal audio
vocal segment audition uses edited source boundaries with preroll/postroll and loop
Both mode has one vocal source, simultaneous audible buses and independent volumes
slow playback preserves source timestamps and requested pitch, with synchronized playhead
Keyboard stays piano in Vocal override and Space plays complete original audio in Piano mode
Escape cancels a drag without symbolic changes or an extra history step
A/B plays original vocal then reference, with no vocal pitch-shift claim
working revision restore appends a correction and review attestation clears on note edits
range tool and missing-note queue windows remain source-aligned without inventing labels
review suggestions are confined to a short reference excerpt
raw predicted notes can be auditioned without populating a blank human reference
Auto routes annotation clicks to original vocal and every keyboard override to clean piano
Audition on click can be disabled; manual note overrides preserve their separate routes
vertical drag previews proposed piano pitch before commit and supports undo
reference framing fits excerpt and pitch events; mode-specific deliberate views survive switching
collapsed resizable inspector and maximize preserve notes, viewport and continuous playback
unique-recording bulk scope, filtered actions and tri-state groups never discard edits or stop playback
model variants and references remain discoverable under their source; search and model filters work
Vocadito source policy requires explicit UI and API opt-in even when all recordings are selected
changing audition mode and corpus selection does not interrupt whole-song playback

limitation: Actual oscillator and decoded media signals measured internally; no acoustic output/device-latency or perceptual singing-quality validation
